newsitem.title: ITALY: Snia Fibre, BPD shares lower.
newsitem.headline: Snia Fibre, BPD shares lower.

text.p: Shares in Italian chemical firm Snia Fibre and its controlling Snia BPD fell on the Milan bourse with traders looking at their book value ahead of their merger.
Snia BPD controls 83.68 percent of Snia Fibre's capital. Both companies are part of the Fiat group which last week announced plans to merge Fibre into BPD.
Analysts put Fibre's book value at around 600 lire and that of BPD at 1,800 lire. The market is expecting a "three Fibre shares for one BPD" swap ratio for the operation.
At 1435 GMT, Snia Fibre shares were quoted 3.25 percent down at 720 lire after a session low at 690. Snia BPD was 2.54 percent lower at 1,730 lire after a low at 1,708.

"The shares are correcting after Monday's swings when Fibre rose by some nine percent and BPD fell," said Fausto Covolanna, analysts at Cimo brokers. "The book values give a value of 1,799 lire for BPD and 593 for Fibre."
